/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/husain-raazi-rahe.md\")
before = path.read_bytes()
opening, roman, source = before.decode().split(\"---\\n\", 2)
metadata, roman = roman.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\", 1)
changes = {
    \"Haider ka mojza Husain\": \"Haider ka mojiza Husain\",
    \"Zehra ka maah-liqa Husain\": \"Zehra ka maah liqa Husain\",
    \"Ye majliseiṅ ye aza khaane\": \"Ye majliseiṅ ya aza khaane\",
    \"Subhaana Rabbiyal Aala Rasul parhte rahe\": \"Subhaana Rabbiyal Aala Rasul kehte rahe\",
    \"Sar apna faqr se uṅcha\": \"Sar apna faqr se uncha\",
    \"Yehi najaat ka zariya banega mahshar meiṅ\": \"Yehi najaat ka zariya bane mahshar meiṅ\",
}
for old, new in changes.items():
    assert roman.count(old) == 1, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
roman_blocks = roman.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
source_blocks = source.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 14
for index, (roman_block, source_block) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    roman_lines = roman_block.splitlines()
    source_lines = source_block.splitlines()
    assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines)
    if index >= 4:
        assert roman_lines[0].strip() == str(index - 3)
        assert source_lines[0] == str(index - 3).translate(str.maketrans(\"0123456789\", \"۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹\"))
assert all(char.isascii() or char in \"ṅṄ\" for char in roman)
after = f\"{opening}---\\n{metadata}romanLyrics: |-\\n{roman}---\\n{source}\".encode()
assert before.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\")[0] == after.split(b\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\")[0]
assert before.split(b\"---\\n\", 2)[2] == after.split(b\"---\\n\", 2)[2]
path.write_bytes(after)
print(\"Verified stanza alignment, verse counts, Roman characters, and byte-identical Urdu and metadata.\")

item.text:
Audited every Roman verse against the Urdu in [Husain Raazi Rahe](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/aafe3dde2861425ca96013de1eee6b6b/src/data/lyrics/husain-raazi-rahe.md). Corrected three wording mismatches (`ye` → `ya`, `parhte` → `kehte`, `banega` → `bane`) and normalized three spellings (`mojiza`, `maah liqa`, `uncha`).

Verified verse alignment and stanza numbering. The Urdu text and all other metadata are unchanged.
